title: Leads > Lead Settings > How to Set Up Lead Generation and Auto-Matching

sections.heading: Automated Lead Matching System
sections.content:
Brilliant Directories includes an automated lead engine that receives visitor inquiries and matches them to suitable professionals based on Category and Geographic Location (City, Zip Code, or Radius).
Admins can choose between Free Leads, Paid Leads (where members pay to purchase the lead contact details), or Preview Leads.

sections.heading: Configuring Lead Auto-Match Rules
sections.content:
1. Navigate to Leads > Lead Settings.
2. Under 'Auto-Match Leads', choose 'Auto-Match and Auto-Send' or 'Admin Manually Approves Leads Before Sending'.
3. Configure Maximum Matches: Set how many members receive each lead (e.g., maximum 3 professionals).
4. In 'Lead Price', define default purchase cost per lead or override by membership plan.
